questions.question: Can you walk us through the most complex Docker multi-stage build or orchestration setup you have configured yourself?
questions.intent: Verify if they have set it up from scratch or just used existing templates.

questions.question: Describe a system architecture decision you made that you later had to refactor due to scaling challenges. What were the trade-offs?
questions.intent: Evaluate architecture maturity and ability to analyze performance bottlenecks.
